**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity).**

Section 12.4 imposes a one-sided restriction on us that fails the fallback on every material term:

- **One-sided** — binds Customer only, not mutual.
- **Duration** — eighteen months post-termination vs. twelve months from end of involvement.
- **Scope** — "any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term," not just personnel directly involved in the Services.
- **No carve-outs** — no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach exception.
- **No-hire** — "solicit or engage" is an outright no-hire, which the playbook treats as walk-away territory. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made *no* no-hire commitment and remain free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

Redline (validated, ok:true) replaces 12.4 with a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, plus general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and an express disclaimer of any no-hire. We narrowed to the fallback rather than deleting outright, since the parties clearly bargained for some restriction and this also resolves the internal conflict with 12.3.
